facts.text: I want to update my LinkedIn profile.
I want to highlight my recent project experience on my LinkedIn profile.

I want to brainstorm ideas for a potential remote job or consulting business based on my marketing and product launch skills and experience.

I am leaning toward marketing consulting.
I enjoy sharing my knowledge and experience with others.
I am passionate about helping businesses achieve their marketing goals.
